# AI Sustained

> Practical, evidence-led writing on AI adoption, capability and agentic workflows by Kevin Clubb (senior business analyst, UK) — plus real-world AI & data case studies. Tagline: "AI that survives Monday morning."

## Case studies
- [Before you write an AI policy, ask the people already using it](https://ai-sustained.com/case-studies/shadow-ai-ask-the-workforce/): shadow AI in the workforce, and building a usage survey by delegating it to an AI agent.
- [What a single source of truth really costs (before you add AI)](https://ai-sustained.com/case-studies/single-source-of-truth/): three routes to one trustworthy data source — warehouse-light, modern data stack, and a multi-site build — with indicative costs and timelines.
- [All case studies](https://ai-sustained.com/case-studies/)

## Editorial (selected)
- [The AI competency pyramid](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/ai-competency-pyramid/): where 20.6m UK workers sit across 14 levels of AI capability.
- [Four labs. Seven days. No clear winner.](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/four-labs-seven-days/): the state of the AI frontier in April 2026.
- [The Renaissance of the Delivery Squad](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/future-delivery-squad/): how AI agents reshape the product team.
- [The Victorians out-spent us](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/ai-vs-industrial-revolution/): AI capex against the railways, Apollo and the Manhattan Project as a share of GDP, and why adoption speed is the real anomaly.
- [Claude now watermarks everything it writes](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/claude-text-watermark-debate/): why an invisible text watermark marks processing rather than authorship, why removal is already trivial, and what that breaks for academia and for anyone writing with AI.
- [The Engine Under the Bonnet](https://ai-sustained.com/articles/ai-models-v-public-detector-dilemma/): the follow up to Issue 017 and the mechanics explainer. How green-list token biasing leaves a statistical fingerprint, what a cryptographic detection key is, why releasing it to the public enables both scrubbing and forgery, and how to proofread with AI without acquiring a mark. Written by Google Gemini, published unedited.
- [All editorial](https://ai-sustained.com/#editorial)
